selection_partition: demo34 held out from demo31--33 fitting
logic: prefer S1 if it passes the tie limit and is within 2 points of the best S1/S1.5/S2 language-counterfactual agreement and ordinary local accuracy
otherwise prefer S1.5 under the same two noninferiority conditions
otherwise choose among tie-passing candidates lexicographically by language-counterfactual agreement, ordinary accuracy, tie deviation, task robustness, log loss, and scalar simplicity
if none passes the tie limit, apply the same lexicographic order diagnostically
